Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Contemporary Tassel Throw Pillow - 17 x 17 Inch, Terracotta
Colors: Terracotta
Made in the United States and imported This bold terracotta throw pillow draws the eye and makes a statement with its vibrant burnt-orange hue. A muted neutral border and tassels add a dramatic, classy touch of fun. 17"L x 17"W Spot Clean.
